title: Role of Interfacial Coherency on Creep Behavior of FCC/BCC High-Entropy Alloy Multilayers.

recollection.starting_material: guess: high-entropy alloy multilayers with FCC and BCC phases
recollection.intervention: guess: varying the interfacial coherency between the layers
recollection.structure: guess: multilayered structure with varying degrees of interfacial coherency
recollection.mechanism: guess: dislocation movement and grain boundary sliding affected by interfacial coherency

score.note: The recollection only generically identifies varying interface coherency and a multilayer structure, largely restating the title.
